title: ID0430394-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002528]  Issue with Router 1 one of the chargers.
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  We have identified an issue with Router 1 in one of our chargers,
which appears to be causing charging sessions to endautomatically. A customer has reported this issue, and uponinvestigation, we found that the router connectivity is unstable.Kindly arrange to fix or replace the router at the earliest to ensurecontinuous and reliable operations.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430394-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 1700025289] Issue with Router 1 one of the chargers. CRM:02682000131
additional_info.body:
Dear Nadeem,
Wishing you a pleasant day ahead!
We have reviewed the charger logs from June 10, based on the pictures you shared. It appears that the charger rebooted on 2025-06-10 at 17:53:43 UTC, which resulted in a temporary loss of router connectivity.
Following the reboot, we observed that one successful charging session was completed:
Session Start
: 2025-06-10 at 18:02:04 UTC (SOC: 41%)
Session End
: 2025-06-10 at 18:45:35 UTC (SOC: 89%)
Transaction ID
: 76675
Additionally, we have noticed some ongoing connectivity issues with the router. Therefore, we are escalating this ticket to our regional service team to conduct an on-site visit and further troubleshoot the issue.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
